method: Fresh independent visible gameplay review, ordinary browser synthetic input with installed headed Chrome software-WebGL fallback. Only driver --help read; no source/state/eval/debug URLs or arranged actors.

ratingRationale.gameplay: Recovering memories while pressured by distinct guards creates a meaningful objective loop. Successful critical eliminations and supply restoration are clear. My two runs ended quickly after navigation and targeting errors; I did not experience the complete boss/upload loop.
ratingRationale.presentation: Strong typography, teal/amber palette, rainy industrial setting and reflective light establish a coherent atmosphere. Repeated primitive geometry and similar robot silhouettes limit visual richness.
ratingRationale.usability: Onscreen controls, paused map and restart are useful. I repeatedly pushed against cover/walls with little immediate understanding of the obstruction, and recovery attempts outside reach failed until I corrected position.
ratingRationale.readability: Objective distance, floor rings, critical feedback and directional damage cues help. Dense contextual text and many small threats compete for attention; some world signs look like actionable objectives without a clear target.
ratingRationale.AAAReadiness: A coherent vertical slice, but these limited visible runs do not show the polish, content depth, animation variety or combat readability expected for that standard. This is an opinion, not certification.

attempts.actions: Shot initial centered induction guard, moved forward and west, opened paused map, reloaded, advanced toward west archive. W movement stalled at 17m; E failed. Space vaults corrected the low-cover obstruction and E recovered Mara. Tried east then north, hit receiver/sign/column geometry, backed away and corrected route. Learned held RMB drag sensitivity through 500/400 pixel turns, then corrected north. Reached Heart at 3.6m; failed E outside reach, moved 450ms closer and recovered Sera. Attempted aim/fire at nearby warden too late and died.
attempts.aimMissesAndCorrections: Initial long burst used 17 rounds for one critical elimination. Late Heart burst did not secure another kill; terminal accuracy 14%. No claim every miss was geometrically blocked.
attempts.boss: No confirmed Custodian damage or disable.
attempts.services: No confirmed service interaction or completion. Core recovery restored supplies.

attempts.actions: Killed initial guard with shorter 700ms burst, headed east, vaulted cover, explored shutter/coil installation near map jammer marker. Fired 22 rounds at visible coil gap, reloaded; no confirmed damage feedback. Circled installation, northward strafe blocked by wall, corrected backward then north. Missed moving sentinel on first 900ms burst; corrected aim 300px and achieved critical elimination. Reached east receiver at 4.7m, E failed; moved 500ms closer and recovered Elian. Approached repair/manual-cutout area and held E 1800ms without confirmed service feedback. Retreated west under fire, fired at interceptor with a Shift input, reached three eliminations. Recovered Sera with E after small position correction, reloaded. Turned 2280px toward west, fled and attempted to navigate around archive enclosure; became blocked and died during next retreat correction.
attempts.aimMissesAndCorrections: Coil fire had no observed damage confirmation, potentially blocked or wrong target. First sentinel aim missed moving target; 300px correction produced critical elimination. Long interceptor burst expended 23 rounds and total kills increased to three, but exact per-shot hits unknown. Terminal accuracy 11%.
attempts.boss: Sought jammer at industrial coils; no visible boss health, confirmed boss damage, or disabled component. Cannot infer boss was harmed from firing.
attempts.services: One deliberate E attempt near repair area, no service hint/completion observed. This may have been wrong position. Core supply restoration confirmed.

controlLearning: UI taught WASD, R reload, Space vault, Shift dash, hold E recover, RMB aim.
Map M pauses mission and clearly marks walls, low cover and receiver reach.
Mouse capture unavailable; held RMB look fallback used. Turn sensitivity required corrections. Largest look delta 2280, below 2400 guard.
Used Shift in attempt 2; end screen reported zero phase evades. Did not test shotgun, crouch or sprint.
strengths: Recovery ring and outside-reach message provide actionable position feedback.
Critical elimination and supply restoration feedback make success understandable.
issues: Repeated wall/cover collisions interrupted navigation despite visible objective markers.
Under fire I struggled to identify and track multiple small robot threats while reading contextual prompts.
Coil/shutter signage invited fire but I could not tell whether my shots affected anything.
uncertainty: Paused synthetic short batches and screenshot scheduling limit assessment of continuous combat.
No audio evaluation, hardware performance benchmark or human enjoyment claim.
Two deaths do not establish full mission balance or boss/upload quality.
UI extraction sometimes differed slightly from photographed health during capture; terminal screens are the outcome evidence.
inputEvidence: Driver generated input/capture logs in own evidence directory.

cleanup.conclusion: Exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent after explicit close and awaited exit 0.
